oracle.inputs: Declared data specification or p-value arrays in this fixture; no expected outputs are inputs to a fit.
oracle.limitations: Fixed-input reference comparison only. No repeated-sampling coverage or causal identification claim.
asserted_outputs: analytic_se (coefficient part after removing modifier-mean variance)
context_only_outputs: coefficients (only interaction coefficient used in variance decomposition)

reference_review.scope: Retained generator, transitive repository comparison helper, locked public comparator APIs, declared inputs and consuming assertion; not verification of every theorem or every method-family scenario.
reference_review.independence_basis: The retained generator constructs reference results through public NumPy, SciPy and statsmodels APIs on repository-owned deterministic inputs. It imports no Antecedent runtime or algorithm/test helper. The only imported repository helper is reference_compare, which compares documents and computes no reference values. Expected numerical outputs enter comparison only after the public reference call. Product assertion source was separately inspected to identify asserted versus context-only fields.
reference_review.historical_exposure: Historical author exposure and deleted generator authorship cannot be independently established from retained artifacts. Original disclosures and environment metadata remain unchanged in historical_oracle or historical_reference; this review does not certify them.
reference_review.redistribution: Retained harness and deterministic inputs are repository-authored under MIT OR Apache-2.0. Committed outputs are numerical API results and contain no upstream implementation or tests. Comparator packages remain in isolated tooling, outside the product and ordinary CI; their versioned license files are linked for environment redistribution obligations.
reference_review.limitations: Fixed-input reference comparison only. No repeated-sampling coverage or causal identification claim.
